subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` as a core public config surface now, and should Lossless `summaryModel` fallback live in the Lossless plugin or in a generic context-engine SDK contract?
rationale: The remaining work adds provider/auth fallback behavior and crosses both core compaction config and plugin-owned context-engine summarization, so automation cannot choose the permanent public API safely.

options.title: Keep Open For Contract Decision
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers choose explicit fallback-list semantics, owner boundaries, and required upgrade/docs proof before implementation.

options.title: Design A Unified Context-Engine Fallback Contract
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one API that can cover embedded compaction, Lossless, and future context-engine summaries.

options.title: Keep Fallbacks Outside Core
options.body: Decline a new core config key and ask operators to use provider plugins, compaction providers, or external routing for summarizer fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Contract Decision
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers choose explicit fallback-list semantics, owner boundaries, and required upgrade/docs proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history on context-engine compaction seams and can decide whether the Lossless half belongs in plugin code or a generic SDK contract.
